observations.ipcRouting: Creator scene IPC allowlist routes executeSceneScriptMethod to edit renderer; preview lifecycle/current-scene/pause methods route to preview renderer.
observations.previewManager: query-preview-data/call-preview-function expose image/specialized preview managers only; no generic extension runtime execution route.

decision: Do not use execute-scene-script for runtime state, audio or particle claims. Implement a finite host Game View adapter for lifecycle/state only. Keep audio/particle runtime rows probe-required and public audio routes fail closed until a separately qualified finite transport exists.
securityBoundary: Private _previewIpc generic send can bypass the native allowlist and was not used.
